tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The bidders shall read, understand, follow the terms and conditions, eligibility cretiria mentioned in the RFP and also upoad the documents which are mandotory.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have successfully executed at least one single Work Order / Purchase Order of a minimum value of 300 Lakhs (3.00 Crore) involving supply of similar IT materials, covering the single item/product with the highest specified quantity under the Technical Bid/RFP. Copy of the Work Order/Purchase Order a shall be uploaded.

The bidder shall have successfully supplied a minimum of 400 Lakhs (4.00 Crore) of the single item/product having the highest specified quantity under the Technical Bid/RFP, during the past three financial years, i.e., 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25, to any Central Government Department, State Government Department, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), Government Body, or Government Educational Institution

The bidder shall have an established office and business establishment within Bengaluru City. The bidder shall be a legally registered Proprietorship, Partnership, Firm Company LLP, as applicable under the relevant prevailing Acts and Rules, and shall have been continuously in business for a minimum period of 5 years as on the last date of submission of the bid. Copies of Registration Certificates, address proof and relevant statutory documents shall be uploaded on the KPPP Portal
The bidder shall possess a valid Goods and Services Tax (GST) Registration Certificate as on the date of submission of the bid. A copy of the valid GST Registration Certificate shall be uploaded.
The bidder shall possess valid Permanent Account Number (PAN) and Tax Deduction and Collection Account Number (TAN) registrations. Copies of valid PAN and TAN documents shall be uploaded.

Wherever applicable, the bidder shall furnish a valid Udyam Registration / MSME Registration Certificate. Eligible MSMEs may claim applicable exemptions/relaxations strictly in accordance with the provisions of the Karnataka Transparency in Public Procurements Act/Rules and applicable Government Orders, subject to submission of valid documentary proof

The bidder shall possess a valid ISO 9001:2015 with the scope covering IT / ITES activities, IT infrastructure, supply/service/support of IT equipment or relevant activities. The certificate shall be valid as on the last date of bid submission

The bidder shall be an Authorized Partner Dealer Reseller System Integrator of the respective OEMs and shall submit valid MAFs for at least three major quantity items products quoted in the Technical Bid, on the respective OEMs letterhead and duly signed by the authorized signatory, as per Section XII of the RFP.

The bidder shall have an annual turnover of not less than 500 Lakhs (5.00 Crore) in each of the three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25. The bidder shall upload a Turnover Certificate duly certified by a Chartered Accountant, along with supporting relevant supply/work order credentials.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall furnish a valid PAN, TAN Registration Number and copies/acknowledgements of Income Tax Returns filed for the three prescribed financial/assessment periods corresponding to FY 2022-23, FY 023-24 and FY 2024-25, as applicable. Documentary proof shall be uploaded on the KPPP Portal.
